name: Battery Level out of Bounds
hint: A battery comparison outside 0–100 describes an impossible charge level and can make power decisions unreliable.
instruction: Accept and compare battery levels only from 0 through 100, and constrain calculated thresholds to that interval.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB battery level :: sensing) > (150)> then
say [Invalid battery level]
end
